messages: mira (design): hey folks, dropping a small prototype for a "mini-preview" compact list for prompt-set evals. goal: let reviewers sweep through failures and approve small batches fast. fig: https://figma.com/proto/mini-preview-ux dan (pm): :rocket: love the goal. two constraints: audit log terminology must match backend events, and we need an explicit undo affordance. also confirm threshold for modal? syl (frontend): implementation note: new select-mode rail appears on multi-select (right edge). rail contains primary action, count, and overflow menu. will try to keep DOM minimal (rail + live region) mira (design): microcopy proposals: rail primary = "Approve tests", secondary = "Investigate", toast = "N tests approved — Undo". confirmation modal title = "Approve tests". modal body = "This will mark N tests as approved in this prompt set. This action can be undone within 12 seconds." dan (pm): backend event is `mark_approved`, so "Approve tests" matches nicely. for threshold, let's show modal if >12 items to reduce accidental sweeps. otherwise quick approve with toast/undo. lee (a11y): accessibility notes: 1) don't rely on color-only for pass/fail; include text/icon. 2) avoid parentheses in visible CTA labels; VoiceOver reads them awkwardly. prefer e.g., "Approve selected — 3" or separate hidden text. 3) when rail appears, update an aria-live region with "3 tests selected"; avoid moving focus. syl (frontend): good recs. technical detail: inserting the rail DOM doesn't always trigger SR announcement on VoiceOver. i'll keep a hidden `div#selection-announce` with `aria-live="polite"` and programmatically set its text on selection changes. also will ensure the rail has `role=region` and `aria-label="Selection actions"`. mira (design): love that. question: should the count be part of the primary button label? previous feedback said parenthesis/unfriendly. maybe primary shows "Approve tests" and the rail has a separate big-count element "3" with `aria-hidden=true` and a sr-only span that reads "3 selected". lee (a11y): yes do that. SR text pattern: `3 tests selected` and visible count `aria-hidden=true`. also ensure the undo button has `aria-label="Undo approve of 3 tests"` when possible. dan (pm): UX flow question: if someone bulk-approves then navigates away before undo timeout, should undo still be available? we should keep undo server-side via an event window for 12s and client toast triggers the undo call if clicked. product OK? mira (design): sounds fine. make sure the toast is keyboard-focusable and appears in DOM order after the action button to be discoverable. copy for toast CTA = "Undo" only. toast text = "3 tests approved". syl (frontend): implementation plan: lazy-render inline mini-preview on hover/click, fade-mask for snippets instead of hard-clamp (fixes mid-word crop on iOS), rail inserted on selection >0, `#selection-announce` updates with exact phrasing. confirmation modal if selection >12. undo window = 12s per product. will ship prototype to staging. ci-bot: preview ready at https://staging.redwood.ai/evals/mini-preview-compact (build 8345) · 92 tests affected lee (a11y): i'll run VoiceOver & NVDA on staging and post any reading issues. quick checklist for reviewers: - rail accessible via keyboard - selection announcer reads counts clearly - primary CTA reads "Approve tests" - snippet fade-mask applied - confirmation modal for >12 selected - undo toast focusable mira (design): thanks! please drop 1-line verification here after testing (keyboard, SR announce, copy). aiming to merge after a11y sign-off.
